title: EVT-DELIVERY-VOIDED
description: TASK-0142 (ITQ-2). live-scoring.md §18.1 step 2 (TASK-0029, Undo) -- §16 itself only mentions this event's existence in passing, with no dedicated field table the way §16.2-16.5 each got one. Modeled minimally per what §18.1's text actually specifies: a reference to the voided event's eventId, nothing more. Transcribes MatchEvent.kt's DeliveryVoided field-for-field.

voidedEventId.description: Refers to an AuditedEvent.eventId, not a MatchEvent itself -- the envelope, not the payload, carries identity.
